topic.name: Agent语义加速
topic.description: 减少Agent反复Read、Grep、Glob、代码探索、上下文构建和规划等待， 从而缩短端到端任务完成时间的技术，而非仅指语义缓存。

工具调用并行、预测或复用是否引入正确性风险

facts.title: Agent Arena 成本数据。
facts.event_hint: Unresolved Agent Arena X post comparing median per-task costs of DeepSeek-V4-Flash, GPT-5.6 Luna, and DeepSeek-V4-Pro
facts.problem: The X post claims that Agent Arena cost-performance comparisons may favor lower median per-task cost, but it does not provide the underlying benchmark page, task distribution, or methodology.
facts.mechanism: No mechanism can be established from this discovery-only X post. It mentions median costs per task for three model configurations, but no task definition, success criterion, token accounting, hardware, or cost source is provided.
facts.evaluation_context: The fetched source is a single X post linking to an unresolved t.co URL. It states $0.024 median cost per task for DeepSeek-V4-Flash (High), $0.026 for GPT-5.6 Luna (xHigh), and a relative position to DeepSeek-V4-Pro (Thinking), but supplies no benchmark details or primary data.
facts.limitations: This is a B-level discovery-only social post with unresolved primary evidence. The quoted cost figures, ranking, task mix, success criteria, and accounting method cannot be independently checked from the referenced document. Do not use the post as quantitative evidence until the Agent Arena source is resolved and fetched.
facts.project_relevance: At most, this is a lead to measure agent selection by cost per successful task rather than token price. No conclusion about context retrieval, tool-call count, latency, quality, or open-weight hardware efficiency is supported here.
source_notes: Discovery-only YeeKal/X source; Agent Arena benchmark link was not resolved in the input.
Evidence intentionally left empty because the primary source is unavailable.
